Definition: feminine of a derivative of στρατός (an army; from the base of G4766, as encamped); camp-likeness, i.e. an army, i.e. (figuratively) the angels, the celestial luminaries:--host.
BiblicalUsage: The host is the army of heaven, and Israel's false worship. Suddenly there is with the angel a multitude of the heavenly host praising God, and God turns and gives Israel up to worship the host of heaven.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the same word names true worship and false: the host praises God at Bethlehem, and the host is worshipped when men turn away.
